🇲🇽🌎 MEXICO INVOKES THE VIENNA CONVENTION AGAINST US PRESSURE

The SRE will keep the diplomatic notes tied to Washington's "narco" accusations against Gov. Rocha Moya, Sen. Inzunza and eight other officials classified — citing the Vienna Convention and Article 112 of the Transparency Law. Sheinbaum already ordered the extradition files opened ahead of schedule, but state-to-state diplomatic cables stay sealed. Mexico decides what it discloses, and when.

🇲🇽🌎 SAME BORDER, TWO MODELS: ICE HUNTS, MEXICO SHELTERS

Days after ICE killed another Mexican national, Welfare Secretary Ariadna Montiel toured the "Leona Vicario" migrant center in Ciudad Juárez — refuge, food, medical care and guidance for people on the move, whether heading north or returning home. The goal, she said, is "a permanent presence in the territory to guarantee direct attention to the population."

🇲🇽🇻🇪 MEXICO PULLED THEM FROM THE RUBBLE — VENEZUELA SAID THANK YOU

After Mexican soldiers deployed to Venezuela and dug survivors out of the June 24 earthquake, Caracas handed the Mexican Army three Belgian Malinois pups in gratitude. Venezuela is also sending two rescue dogs, Sol and Sara, with their handlers to train at Mexico's Military Police academy through December. Solidarity between sovereign nations — help given, help returned.

🇲🇽🏦 NU IS NOW MEXICO'S BIGGEST DIGITAL BANK

Mexico's banking regulator (CNBV) just cleared Nu to operate as a full bank. With 15+ million clients, it instantly becomes the largest digital bank in the country — started in 2019 as a single credit card, now cleared to offer payroll accounts and deposit insurance up to 3.5 million pesos. Financial inclusion at scale, under Mexican regulation.

UPI: Mexico accuses former U.S. ambassador of lying over cartel case
July 9, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Ken Salazar insisted US agencies had no role in the 2024 capture of "El Mayo" Zambada. Mexico's Attorney General now says he lied — after the FBI displayed the plane used in the operation at a New Mexico museum, billed as "an FBI success." 💀

UPI notes Salazar will face no consequences: diplomatic immunity shields him.

• Sheinbaum: "Everything seems to indicate that Ken Salazar lied"
• Salazar: "It wasn't our plane, nor our pilot, nor our operation"

REUTERS: Mexico's drug cartel crackdown fails to dent fentanyl flow to US, report says
July 10, 2026 | 🟡

📰 The headline says "failure." The International Crisis Group report it cites documents 2,500 arrests, 68 tons of narcotics seized, nearly 100 extraditions and up to 15,000 troops deployed to Sinaloa. 🇲🇽

The frame never asks why the world's largest fentanyl market sits north of the border, or where the cartels' guns come from — US officials themselves told researchers the flow reflects demand and shifting smuggling, not Mexican inaction.

• report concedes Mexico "scored tactical victories against criminal groups under pressure from the Trump administration"
• "no noticeable impact on fentanyl prices or availability" — attributed to US officials

AP: Mexico to request criminal charges over deaths following fatal shooting of Houston man by ICE agents
July 9, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Mexico will seek charges over 17 citizens dead in ICE custody or operations — but AP leads its account of the Houston killing with DHS's claim the man "attempted to ram an agent," and notes the request "carries no legal weight." 🔍

14 died in ICE custody, 3 during ICE operations. Salgado Araujo had lived in the US for decades and was driving a work crew to a construction site when he was shot.

• Sheinbaum: "We are going to do everything in our power, because we cannot stand silent"
• the deaths of Mexicans "whose only crime is working honestly in the United States"

🇲🇽📈 <u>MEXICO'S SOCIAL SPENDING SURGES: EDUCATION +21%, HEALTH +20.9% REAL IN 2026</u>

SHCP's public-finance report shows that from January to May 2026, real annual spending rose +21% on education and +20.9% on health, with overall social-development spending up 13.1% — above the last decade's average, per El Economista. Health investment tripled in real terms versus 2025 — all while inflation sits at a 5-year low (3.37% in June).

🇲🇽🌽 <u>4 BILLION PESOS FOR THE P'URHÉPECHA PEOPLE — HEALTH, SCHOOLS, ROADS, WATER</u>

One year and two months into the Plan de Justicia for the P'urhépecha people of Michoacán, President Sheinbaum reported over 4 billion pesos invested across 146 communities: 646 doctors and more than 1,000 nurses hired, a new ISSSTE hospital, and 27 community-built "artisanal roads" (485 million pesos) — plus schools, water, housing, farm support and the recovery of Paracho's guitar-making tradition, decided with the pueblos, not for them.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO'S MET SERVICE FORECASTS A "VERY STRONG" EL NIÑO INTO 2027</u>

Mexico's Servicio Meteorológico Nacional puts the odds of El Niño forming at 97–100%, with a 63% chance it reaches "very strong" — on par with the 1997-98 and 2015-16 events — peaking November 2026 to January 2027. Sea-surface temperatures in the Niño 3.4 region have already hit 29.2°C, just 0.2° below the November 2015 record. Expect rainfall deficits across central, southern and southeastern Mexico this summer, then a wetter, colder northern winter. "The trend is consistent with a very strong forming El Niño," the SMN coordinator said.
